input: scheduled: continue work on the repo (develop, deploy, market, sell, support)

doc_friction.issue: Step 0 asks to fix every open entry first, but all 11 open entries are control-plane edits that need owner-approved PRs; the list cannot shrink from an ordinary run, so it reads as blocking when it is not.

notes: Target ventures/rev-rec (new, finance-critical). Two real defects in stripe.mjs/server.mjs found by reading, outside the mutated files: basil taxes[] shape ignored; created-filtered incremental sync missed late-paid invoices and voided credit notes. Also fixed README known gap: time-of-day periods counted an extra day. rev-rec 62 tests pass. Sibling sweep: no other venture reads tax_amounts; changepoint-detector's created filter is correct for charges. No new CI guard: the class (Stripe API shape drift) is product-specific; README now documents both tax shapes.

real_defects.issue: Stripe API 2025-03-31 (basil) and later send taxes[{tax_behavior:'inclusive'}] instead of tax_amounts[{inclusive:true}]; normalizeLine checked only `inclusive` and normalizeCreditNote read only tax_amounts, so an account on the current API version booked tax-inclusive VAT/GST as revenue. Fixed with a shared inclusiveTax() that reads both shapes; failing-first test in stripe.test.mjs.

Incremental sync asked Stripe for invoices created in the last 3 days, but billing is by paid date: an invoice issued earlier and paid later (net-30) was never picked up after the first sync, and a credit note voided after it was read was never dropped. Fixed with a full re-read that replaces the line set at least every 24 h (cfg.fullSyncMs); failing-first test in server.test.mjs.
